statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-5674 is a sandbox escape in PipeWire's PulseAudio compatibility server: a sandboxed local client can make the server load an attacker-controlled library outside the sandbox. This image contains only libpipewire-0.3-0t64 as a browser multimedia client dependency. It does not contain the pipewire or pipewire-pulse executables, the PulseAudio compatibility server, or the gstreamer1.0-pulseaudio package, so the vulnerable server-side code and library-loading path are absent.
